text_zh: 兔子比小鸡重，小猪比兔子重。这三种动物哪一种最重？
text_en: The rabbit is heavier than the chick, and the pig is heavier than the rabbit. Which of the three animals is the heaviest?
explanation_zh: 小猪 > 兔子 > 小鸡，所以小猪最重。
explanation_en: Pig > rabbit > chick, so the pig is the heaviest.

text_zh: 三个小朋友排成一队。小明不是第一个，小红不是最后一个，小刚排在小明的紧后面。小明排第几？
text_en: Three children stand in a line. Xiaoming is not first, Xiaohong is not last, and Xiaogang stands right behind Xiaoming. Which place is Xiaoming in?
explanation_zh: 小刚紧挨在小明后面，小明只能是第 1 或第 2；又因为小明不是第 1，所以小明第 2、小刚第 3、小红第 1。
explanation_en: Xiaogang is right behind Xiaoming, so Xiaoming can only be 1st or 2nd; since he is not 1st, Xiaoming is 2nd, Xiaogang 3rd, and Xiaohong 1st.

text_zh: 今天是星期三。后天再过 3 天是星期几？
text_en: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be 3 days after the day after tomorrow?
explanation_zh: 今天星期三，后天是星期五。从星期五往后数 3 天：星期六（1 天）、星期日（2 天）、星期一（3 天），所以是星期一。
explanation_en: Today is Wednesday, so the day after tomorrow is Friday. Three days past Friday are Saturday (1), Sunday (2), and Monday (3) — so it is Monday.

text_zh: 小明、小红、小刚各戴了一顶不同颜色的帽子：红色、黄色、蓝色。小明没有戴红帽子，小红戴的既不是红帽子也不是黄帽子。小刚戴的是什么颜色的帽子？
text_en: Xiaoming, Xiaohong, and Xiaogang each wear a hat of a different color: red, yellow, and blue. Xiaoming is not wearing red. Xiaohong is wearing neither red nor yellow. What color is Xiaogang's hat?
explanation_zh: 小红不戴红也不戴黄，只能戴蓝；小明不戴红，蓝又被小红戴了，只能戴黄；剩下的红帽子是小刚的。
explanation_en: Xiaohong wears neither red nor yellow, so she wears blue. Xiaoming is not in red and blue is taken, so he wears yellow. That leaves the red hat for Xiaogang.

text_zh: 小蚂蚁要从方格图的左下角 A 点走到右上角 B 点，只能沿着格线向右或向上走。最短的路线一共有几条？
text_en: A little ant walks from point A at the bottom-left corner of the grid to point B at the top-right corner. It may only move right or up along the grid lines. How many shortest routes are there?
explanation_zh: 最短路线都是走 4 步：向右 2 步、向上 2 步。只要定下哪两步向上就行：右上右上、右上上右、右右上上、上右右上、上右上右、上上右右，共 6 条。
explanation_en: Every shortest route takes 4 steps: 2 right and 2 up. Choosing which steps go up gives RURU, RUUR, RRUU, URRU, URUR, UURR — 6 routes.
